findings.summary: R1 milestone mapping incomplete: M2 (DAG work plan) does not directly validate plan_package_final.json acceptance or rejection of non-canonical inputs as required by R1.

evidence.note: R1 requires accepting frozen plan_package_final.json and rejecting chat logs/non-canonical inputs.
evidence.quote: SHALL accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json... and SHALL reject chat logs or any non-canonical/unapproved upstream artifacts

evidence.note: M2 focuses on work_plan compilation and does not include exit criteria validating R1 input acceptance/rejection.

findings.summary: R2 milestone mapping includes M2 but M2 exit criteria do not explicitly verify repo_context.json schema validation or presence before code-generation stages as required by R2.

evidence.note: R2 requires repo_context.json schema validation and presence before code-generation stages.
evidence.quote: orchestrator validators SHALL fail the run if repo_context.json is missing or schema-invalid, and repo_context.json SHALL be required before any code-generation stage begins

evidence.note: M2 exit criteria focus on work_plan validity and semantic deviations, not repo_context.json validation.

findings.summary: R3 milestone mapping includes M2 but M2 exit criteria do not explicitly verify workspace_context.json schema validation or presence before workspace-writing stages as required by R3.

evidence.note: R3 requires workspace_context.json schema validation and presence before workspace-writing stages.
evidence.quote: orchestrator validators SHALL fail the run if workspace_context.json is missing or schema-invalid, and workspace_context.json SHALL be required before any workspace-writing stage begins

evidence.note: M2 exit criteria do not mention workspace_context.json validation.

findings.summary: AT1 procedure does not specify structured error format or schema for rejection messages, reducing testability of R1 rejection behavior.

evidence.note: R1 requires rejection of non-canonical inputs.
AT1 pass criteria mention 'structured errors' but do not define schema or format.
evidence.quote: runs (b) and (c) are rejected with structured errors indicating non-canonical planning inputs are not authoritative
